sources.summary: Arcola theatre, London This slick production of Morgan Lloyd Malcolm’s adaptation is hampered by its own cleverness Here is Henry James’s canonical ghost story with modern-day jump scares. And, more audaciously, a new framing device by writer-adapter, Morgan Lloyd Malcolm, which explains itself in a final, added, twist. The jump scares do their work, Hattie North’s jagged sound design enacting its shocks, and the production is slick and stylised – but not all the elements pay off. At Arcola theatre, London , until 10 October Continue reading...
